title: profile
description: A profile's public card, at the path `profile`: one per profile. A profile lives in one market, as one side of it; a badge counts for it only under market/role. Markets may add fields.

market.description: The one market this profile lives in, as the markets directory spells it.

role.description: Its side in that market: seller or buyer in a two-sided market, peer in a one-sided one.

contact.description: How to reach this profile, in the owner's words.

photo.description: Profile photo, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.
